name: Dr. Syed Mozaffar
bio: Dr. Syed Mozaffar is the founder and lead physiotherapist at The Muscular Junction in Islamabad, specialising in sports injury rehabilitation and advanced manual therapy. He also leads the clinic's professional physiotherapy workshops on dry needling, cupping, Mulligan and HVLA techniques.

name: Dr. Niha Batool
bio: Dr. Niha specializes in rehabilitation, helping patients regain mobility, balance, and independence after injury or illness.

name: Dr. Abdul Wahab
bio: Dr. Abdul Wahab is dedicated to helping children achieve developmental milestones through engaging and child-friendly physiotherapy programs.
